finding: members are contig/locus-style identifiers, e.g. '2013843002.a:DCKB1_C844_000013875_0000'. Not rt_hash.
why_it_matters: Every g5 join is on rt_hash (sha256 of the amino-acid sequence, computed in THIS project). The research contract records that inherited rt_hash is not a sequence hash and that no rt_hash to locus link exists, so these clusters cannot be attached to the g6 population at all without new derivation work.
